summary: Frontend-only verification of the Italian static site for Alessandro Immobile. Verified both reported bugs are fixed: (1) full content rendering on all menu pages via SPA navigation, direct URL load and browser back/forward (0 elements with opacity<0.9 inside <main> on every page); (2) navy accent #1B2A4A = rgb(27,42,74) computed on brand, all Home 'Scopri di piu' links, 'Leggi' links, footer 'Scrivimi', and Contatti email/LinkedIn links. Also verified all 6 nav routes + H1s, all 5 deep-links, Contatti mailto/LinkedIn attributes, footer presence on every page (incl. 404), per-page document.title, mobile menu, and 404 route. No console errors. Backend testing skipped as requested (static site, no backend).
critical_code_review_comments: Editorial.jsx FadeIn now uses mount-based initial/animate which correctly fixes the whileInView opacity-0 bug on SPA navigation; no regression found. Optional: respect prefers-reduced-motion in FadeIn for accessibility.

Footer is rendered in normal document flow (not position:fixed). Requirement wording said 'fixed identical footer'; it is identical on every page which appears to be the intent - confirm with user if a sticky footer was actually wanted.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Base URL https://governance-startup.preview.emergentagent.com. Static React SPA, no backend/DB. Coverage already done: all 6 menu routes (SPA nav + direct load), 4 deep pages via 5 inline deeplinks, navy color assertions on 9 elements, footer on every page + 404, per-page titles, mobile menu (390x844), browser back/forward content integrity. Useful assertion: count elements inside <main> with computed opacity<0.9 to catch the framer-motion regression. All passed on this iteration.
rca_of_the_issue: Original bug 1: framer-motion whileInView left off-screen blocks at opacity 0 after SPA navigation (IntersectionObserver never fired because scroll position reset). Fixed by switching FadeIn to mount-based initial/animate. Original bug 2: navy accent token missing/unapplied in tailwind config. Fixed by navy DEFAULT #1B2A4A + navy-soft and applying text-navy to brand and links. Both verified resolved via computed-style and opacity assertions.
